column1: #  SHARED FIXTURE - DUPLICATED ACROSS TWO REPOSITORIES - KEEP BYTE-IDENTICAL
#  Cross-runtime golden table for Iceberg geometry reads. Each record is:
#      <WKT> TAB <ISO WKB, hex> TAB <internal geometry encoding, hex>
#  The WKB column is what an Iceberg `geometry` column holds on disk. The internal column is what a
#  GEOMETRY block/vector must hold after the read. Presto's Java worker produces those bytes with
#  EsriGeometrySerde and the Prestissimo/Velox worker with
#  common::geospatial::GeometrySerializer. Both must produce exactly these bytes: a geometry value
#  read by one runtime crosses exchange, spill and coordinator boundaries and may be interpreted by
#  the other, so a divergence here is a silent data-corruption bug.
#  DRIFT GUARD. The SHA-256 below is over the record lines only (every line that is neither blank
#  nor a comment, joined with '\n' and terminated by one '\n'). Both repositories assert it:
#  Changing the internal encoding of either runtime therefore requires, in one deliberate step:

#    3. explaining in the commit message why the encoding changed and how already-written data and
